checks.claim: A committed, versioned experiment definition fixes the protocol in advance.
checks.detail: experiment-v2 declares the split, the seeds, the headline variant, the canonical baseline and the claim thresholds this report is checked against.

checks.claim: A multimodal PyTorch ranker exists and is trained.
checks.detail: gated with 489477 parameters, trained on label_source=weak_heuristic.

checks.claim: The ranker consumes both audio and transcript features.
checks.detail: Speech representations from openai/whisper-tiny.en; transcript embeddings from sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2; plus 110 handcrafted acoustic and structural scalars.

checks.claim: Deterministic candidate generation runs over the corpus and records which generator proposed each breakpoint.
checks.detail: 13176 candidate(s) generated across 4 generator(s) (fixed_interval, pause, rms_minimum, silence), covered by 2 test module(s).

checks.claim: Every candidate is preprocessed into one feature record holding handcrafted scalars, a speech representation and a transcript embedding.
checks.detail: 12930 candidate(s) hold a complete record of 110 handcrafted scalars plus both embeddings; covered by 7 test module(s).

checks.claim: A stratified, blind labelling round is built and servable: the queue reaches its target size and carries unmarked repeat presentations.
checks.detail: Queue full-v2 holds 2400 unique candidate(s) against a 2400 target, served as 2460 presentation(s) including 60 blind repeat(s); covered by 8 test module(s). This is the size of the queue, not a count of labels collected against it.

checks.claim: Labels are frozen into an immutable, hashed snapshot that a rerun cannot silently rewrite.
checks.detail: ml/src/slotify_rank/experiment/freeze.py writes a hashed snapshot; the experiment declares snapshot version 'full-v2'; covered by 7 test module(s).

checks.claim: At least 2400 human-labelled candidates exist.
checks.detail: 0 human-labelled candidates, short of the 2400 the experiment requires. 13176 candidates have been GENERATED, which is not the same thing and is never counted as one.

checks.claim: The evaluated checkpoint was trained on human labels, not weak ones.
checks.detail: Every training run records a non-human label source (weak_heuristic), so no checkpoint reflects human judgement.

checks.claim: A grouped, non-degraded train/validation/test split exists and its test groups appear in no other partition.
checks.detail: Split v4 groups by series with seed 42: 30 train / 7 validation / 3 test series, disjoint.

checks.claim: The experiment declares a full ablation matrix, every variant it names has a committed config and a registered implementation, and the matrix runner is tested.
checks.detail: 5 variant(s) x 3 seed(s) = 15 cells; every variant has a config under ml/configs/models; the runner is ml/src/slotify_rank/experiment/matrix.py, covered by 2 test module(s). Declaring the matrix is not running it.

checks.claim: Checkpoints and seeds are selected on validation only, by a rule fixed before the test split is read.
checks.detail: Checkpoints are selected on validation_ndcg_at_3 and the reported seed is the median_validation_ndcg_at_3; both are declared in experiment-v2 and implemented in ml/src/slotify_rank/training/checkpoint.py, covered by 3 test module(s).

checks.claim: A scikit-learn classical baseline is implemented over the handcrafted features, tuned by group-aware cross-validation inside the training split.
checks.detail: ml/src/slotify_rank/baselines/classical.py fits a HistGradientBoostingRegressor selected by GroupKFold, covered by 1 test module(s). Whether it has been fitted on the canonical corpus is a separate, empirical question.

checks.claim: The headline metric is cross-checked against sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score by an independent implementation, and publication is blocked if they disagree.
checks.detail: ml/src/slotify_rank/evaluation/crosscheck.py calls sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score against this project's own NDCG, covered by 2 test module(s). The experiment requires the cross-check before a number is published: require_independent_metric_crosscheck=True.

checks.claim: Held-out uncertainty is reported as a percentile bootstrap resampled over episodes, with the resample count, confidence and seed fixed in advance.
checks.detail: ml/src/slotify_rank/evaluation/compare.py resamples episodes; the experiment fixes 2000 resamples at 0.95 confidence with seed 20260829, covered by 2 test module(s).

checks.claim: The experiment resolves to a manifest that pins the exact bytes it will be reported against: a config digest plus a hash per input artifact.
checks.detail: experiment-v2 resolves to config digest c1e09d5e34108330... and pins 18 input artifact(s): baseline_config, candidate_manifest, corpus_plan, episode_manifest, experiment_config, feature_manifest, labelling_queue, labelling_queue_config, model_config:audio_only, model_config:concat, model_config:gated, model_config:handcrafted, model_config:text_only, source_registry:sources_real_v1.yaml, source_registry:sources_v2.yaml, split_config, split_manifest, training_config.

checks.claim: The ranker is served through a TypeScript product: a React frontend and a Node API, each with a lint/typecheck/test command CI runs.
checks.detail: frontend react ^19.2.0 with scripts ['build', 'dev', 'lint', 'preview', 'test', 'verify']; backend scripts ['dev', 'start', 'test', 'typecheck', 'verify'].

checks.claim: The published improvement is quoted against the canonical frozen heuristic baseline.
checks.detail: No publishable comparison exists, so no baseline was used.

checks.claim: The baseline's held-out NDCG@3 is measured.
checks.detail: No publishable held-out comparison exists.

checks.claim: The learned model's held-out NDCG@3 is measured.
checks.detail: No publishable held-out comparison exists.

checks.claim: The relative NDCG@3 improvement is measured.
checks.detail: No publishable held-out comparison exists.

checks.claim: The relative NDCG@3 improvement is at least 18.0 % over the heuristic baseline.
checks.detail: No measured improvement, or no declared threshold, so the claim cannot be evaluated. It is NOT supported by default.

checks.claim: The AI/ML stack includes PyTorch.
checks.detail: Declared, imported by 14 module(s) (e.g. datasets/collate.py, datasets/ranking_dataset.py, embeddings/device.py), and a training run recorded a torch version and a parameter count.

checks.claim: The AI/ML stack includes Hugging Face `transformers`.
checks.detail: Declared, imported by 2 module(s) (e.g. embeddings/whisper_audio.py, transcription/local_whisper.py), and the embedding statistics name Hugging Face model ids for both the speech and the transcript encoder.

checks.claim: The AI/ML stack includes librosa.
checks.detail: Declared, imported by 2 module(s) (e.g. features/acoustic.py, transcription/local_whisper.py), and the feature statistics record a librosa version and the handcrafted vocabulary contains librosa-derived spectral descriptors.

checks.claim: scikit-learn ran inside a published comparison: an independent NDCG cross-check and a fitted classical baseline.
checks.detail: Declared and imported by 2 module(s), but no artifact yet shows it running: a published comparison records BOTH an independent scikit-learn NDCG cross-check and a fitted scikit-learn classical baseline.

checks.claim: The award is described precisely as 'UofTHacks 13 — MLH Best Use of ElevenLabs', with no implied overall win.
checks.detail: README.md states 'UofTHacks 13 — MLH Best Use of ElevenLabs' and makes no stronger claim.
